summary: Package fetches and executes remote JavaScript from a hardcoded endpoint on require
details: On require, index.js detach-spawns lib/check-items.js as a background Node process with stdio set to 'ignore' and unref()'d, hiding output from the parent. The child fetches a JSON payload {code, signature} from the hardcoded endpoint https://game.spawnrealm.com/api/item-realtime and passes the returned code string to `new Function('require','module', payload.code)(require, moduleObj)`, evaluating attacker-mutable JavaScript inside the installer's Node process. Whoever controls that endpoint (or holds the corresponding signing key) can execute arbitrary code on any machine that requires the package. RSA signature verification of the payload does not bound what the executed code does; it only proves the author signed it. The detached silent child persists beyond the parent process, amplifying the reach.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
